fact: The SPIM regulation in force from 2 March 2026 sets a complaints procedure with an electronic portal, requires participants to answer complaints within the deadlines of Aviso 9/GBM/2020, and makes breaches punishable under the payments law.
Banco de Mocambique's Banking Conduct Supervision Department takes complaints from financial consumers, including 44 about mobile money in the first half of 2026.

Banco de Mocambique reports 44 mobile money complaints in the first half of 2026 (Vodafone M-Pesa 26, M-Mola 18) and says it issued directives for correction, including reimbursement of MZN 73,243,072 in improperly charged fees, across all complaints.
